name: Charades
description: A dataset of daily-activity videos annotated with multilabel temporal intervals for 157 actions. STAIR Actions is an extension with additional annotations. This metadata record does not vendor dataset data.
citation: Charades: Sigurdsson, G. A., Varol, G., Wang, X., et al. (2016). Hollywood in Homes: Crowdsourcing Data Collection for Activity Understanding. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
